info.name: Multi-Tenancy API (BETA) BinExplode Message Groups API

params.name: attachment_name__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided attachment name

params.name: attachment_sha256__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided attachment SHA256

params.name: attack_score_verdict__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided attack score verdict

params.name: attack_surface_reduction__filter
params.description: Filters result to only message groups that have flagged (ONLY) rules with the 'Attack surface reduction' tag

params.name: canonical_id__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided canonical ID

params.name: created_at__gte
params.description: Inclusive start datetime filter, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-03-14T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups that contain a message processed at or after this time will be returned.

params.name: created_at__lt
params.description: Exclusive end datetime filter, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-05-04T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups that contain a message processed before this time will be returned.

params.name: first_message_reported_at[gte]
params.description: DEPRECATED: Use first_message_reported_at__gte

params.name: first_message_reported_at__gte
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with a message first reported at or after the provided time. Datetime must be in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-03-14T15:09:26Z').

params.name: flagged
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with at least one flagged message

params.name: flagged_rule_id__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided flagged rule ID

params.name: flagged_rule_severity__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided flagged rule severity

params.name: historically_flagged_rule_id__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided historically flagged rule ID

params.name: historically_flagged_rule_severity__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided historically flagged rule severity

params.name: last_message_created_at[gte]
params.description: DEPRECATED: Use created_at__gte instead

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of message groups to return. If the value exceeds the maximum, then the maximum value will be used.

params.name: mailbox_email__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided mailbox email

params.name: offset
params.description: The (zero-based) offset of the message groups to return

params.name: recipient_email__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided recipient email

params.name: reported_as_phish_by__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided reporter

params.name: reviewed
params.description: Filters result to only message groups which have or have not been reviewed

params.name: sender_display_name__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided sender display name

params.name: sender_domain__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided sender domain

params.name: sender_email__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided sender email

params.name: spam__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided spam status

params.name: subject__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided subject

params.name: user_reported
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with at least one reported message

params.name: vendor_id__is
params.description: Filters result to only message groups with the provided vendor

params.name: any
params.description: Searches every field (performs a case insensitive, OR search in all fields). Not compatible with other search fields.

params.name: attachment_md5
params.description: Search for messages containing an attachment MD5 match

params.name: attachment_sha1
params.description: Search for messages containing an attachment SHA1 match

params.name: attachment_sha256
params.description: Search for messages containing an attachment SHA256 match

params.name: created_at[gte]
params.description: Inclusive start datetime filter for search, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-03-14T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups with a message processed at or after this time will be returned.

params.name: created_at[lt]
params.description: Exclusive end datetime filter for search, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-05-04T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups with a message processed before this time will be returned.

params.name: created_at[lte]
params.description: Deprecated, use created_at[lt]. Exclusive end datetime filter for search, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-05-04T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups with a message processed before this time will be returned.

params.name: file_name
params.description: Search in attachment filenames (case insensitive wildcard match)

params.name: first_reported_as_phish_at[gte]
params.description: Inclusive start datetime filter for search, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-03-14T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups reported at or after this time will be returned.

params.name: first_reported_as_phish_at[lt]
params.description: Exclusive end datetime filter for search, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-05-04T15:09:26Z'). Only message groups reported before this time will be returned.

params.name: from
params.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'sender' instead. Search in the From field. (case insensitive wildcard match)

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of message groups to return. If the value exceeds the maximum, then the maximum value will be used.

params.name: mailbox
params.description: Search for a mailbox by email address (case insensitive, wildcard match)

params.name: message_id
params.description: Search in the Message-ID header (case insensitive wildcard match)

params.name: offset
params.description: The (zero-based) offset of the message groups to return

params.name: sender
params.description: Search in the From field (case insensitive wildcard match)

params.name: states
params.description: Search for messages in any of the given states

params.name: subject
params.description: Search in the message subject (case insensitive wildcard match)

params.name: to
params.description: Search in the To, CC, and Bcc fields (case insensitive wildcard match). If possible, use 'mailbox' and 'type' instead for better performance

params.name: type
params.description: Search for messages by type

info.name: Get SIEM-oriented summary of flagged message groups

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned in the previous response's cursor field.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of message groups to return.

params.name: timestamp__gte
params.description: Inclusive lower bound on the sort timestamp (newest_created_at for type=flagged, first_reported_as_phish_at for type=reported).

params.name: timestamp__lt
params.description: Exclusive upper bound on the sort timestamp (newest_created_at for type=flagged, first_reported_as_phish_at for type=reported).

params.name: type
params.description: Which timestamp the endpoint sorts/filters on: 'flagged' uses newest_created_at, 'reported' uses first_reported_as_phish_at.

items.docs: Returns a paginated, reduced-field summary of flagged message groups intended for SIEM ingestion. Array fields are bounded to keep payloads under typical SIEM batch limits.

Trash all messages in multiple groups, including future messages. For an Office 365 message source, each message will be moved to the "Recoverable Items" folder. For a Google Workspace message source, the "Trash" label will be added to each message.
